unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U07: Map registry functions and supplementary registration duties

facts.statement: Sections20-22 establish registry, registrar and records;20A integration requires notified arrangements and date;20B delegation by notification. Registry supplements other applicable registration laws.

payload.title: A registry search has a specific job
payload.core_explanation_md:
Use the Central Registry to trace the recorded securitisation, reconstruction and security-interest transactions. The Central Registrar controls its record; this is different from a court deciding contested title. Section20 also preserves other applicable registration requirements. A Central Registry filing therefore cannot simply replace registration required under company, property or other relevant legislation.

Integration under section 20A is a notified mechanism with a specified operative date; it is not established merely because two databases are technically connected. Section20B separately permits the described delegation to RBI. A sound checklist names the relevant registry, legal filing and proof of completion for each requirement.

self_check.prompt_text: Does one successful filing necessarily satisfy every registration law?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Identify each applicable legal duty and any actual notified integration.

payload.stem_md: A lender finds a Central Registry acknowledgement and closes an otherwise applicable company-charge filing task. Which conclusion is justified?

options.text_md: The acknowledgement proves every other filing was completed
options.explanation_md: One system record does not establish compliance with a different legal requirement.

options.text_md: The borrower can choose which statute it prefers
options.explanation_md: Applicable duties cannot be displaced by preference alone.

options.text_md: Check the separate company-law duty and any actual integration notification
options.explanation_md: The registry framework supplements other applicable registration requirements.

options.text_md: A registry entry is necessarily a judicial title judgment
options.explanation_md: Recording a transaction is not a merits adjudication of every title issue.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The registry framework supplements other applicable registration requirements.

payload.stem_md: Two systems exchange data, but no relevant integration notification or operative date is established. How should section 20A compliance be recorded?

options.text_md: Not established until the applicable notified mechanism and date are evidenced
options.explanation_md: Technical exchange alone does not prove the statutory integration conditions.

options.text_md: Automatically complete because the data formats match
options.explanation_md: Format compatibility is not a notification.

options.text_md: Complete on the date staff first tested a connection
options.explanation_md: An internal test date is not the legal effective date.

options.text_md: Impossible because electronic records are prohibited
options.explanation_md: The registry framework permits electronic records.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Technical exchange alone does not prove the statutory integration conditions.
